question: What was the name of the Indian contender at the 72nd edition of the Miss World, 2025, pageant, held in Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nandini Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nandini Gupta** represented **India** at the **72nd edition of the Miss World pageant** held in **2025** in **Telangana**.
 
• **Miss World** is one of the oldest and most prestigious international beauty pageants, started in **1951**. It attracts participants from across the globe and celebrates beauty, talent, intelligence, and social contribution.
 
• **Nandini Gupta** gained recognition due to her **poise, intelligence, and exceptional performance** during the pageant's competitive rounds, including talent showcases, interviews, and social projects. *Hence, this answer is correct.*
 
• The choice of **Telangana** as the venue for the Miss World 2025 pageant was significant. It highlighted India's growing influence in hosting international events and showcased the state's **culture, heritage, and infrastructure.**
 
• Nandini Gupta's participation reflects India's continued presence and success in international beauty pageants, with several Indian contestants historically winning the **Miss World title**, including **Reita Faria (1966), Aishwarya Rai (1994), Priyanka Chopra (2000), and Manushi Chhillar (2017).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Nandini Gupta:**

 
 
• **Age:** At the time of the Miss World 2025 pageant, Nandini Gupta was **24 years old.**
 
• **Location:** Nandini hails from **Kota, Rajasthan**, which is well-known for its educational institutions and cultural heritage.
 
• **Achievements:** Apart from her participation in Miss World, Nandini Gupta had also won the **Femina Miss India title** in **2023**, showcasing her talent and charisma on national and international stages.
 
 
 
• **Role of Telangana in Hosting Miss World:**
 
 
• Telangana's selection as the venue for Miss World 2025 reflects India's ability to host large-scale international events. The state is known for its **rich history, cultural heritage, and modern infrastructure.**
 
• **Example:** Hyderabad, the capital of Telangana, has emerged as a global hub for **technology, tourism, and events**, making it an ideal location for such pageants.
 
 
 
• **Miss World Pageant Overview:**
 
 
• The Miss World pageant emphasizes not only beauty but also social responsibility through its **“Beauty with a Purpose” initiative,** which encourages contestants to undertake social projects.
 
• It has been instrumental in raising awareness about various global issues like **education, healthcare, and women's empowerment.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Notable Indian Miss World Winners:**

 
 
• **Reita Faria (1966):** She was the first Indian and Asian to win the Miss World title.
 
• **Aishwarya Rai (1994):** Known for her beauty and intelligence, Aishwarya later became a successful actress.
 
• **Priyanka Chopra (2000):** After winning Miss World, Priyanka Chopra has established herself as a global icon in entertainment.
 
• **Manushi Chhillar (2017):** Manushi's win reinforced India's dominance in the beauty pageant sphere.
 
 
 
• **Telangana as a Venue:**
 
 
• Telangana has hosted various international events, showcasing its **hospitality, infrastructure, and cultural diversity.**
